header.title: Ring Promoter
header.subtitle: CI/CD Orbit + Lanes — every release earns production
header.description: Ring Promoter is TenthMatrix’s production-grade promotion control plane. v1.0.2 puts Orbit (fleet view) and Lanes (APP × INT/TEST/ACC/PROD matrix) side by side while promoting versions through ordered rings — int → test → acc → prod — with live health gates, auto-rollback, and a full audit trail.

intro.title: What is Ring Promoter?
intro.body: A small control plane that promotes application versions through shared rings. It runs as a long-lived service (typically on k3s), exposes a JSON REST API and an embedded web UI, and tracks current/previous versions and history per (application, ring). Kubernetes apps and VM/CI apps share one surface — the deployer is chosen per app.

howItWorks.title: How ring promotion works
howItWorks.intro: Every release earns production. One hop at a time — never skip a ring — with health before promote and auto-rollback on failure.

flow.title: 1. Seed a version into int
flow.text: Start the pipeline by seeding a version (image tag, branch, or ref) into the Integration ring for an application.

flow.title: 2. Promote one ring at a time
flow.text: promote {from_ring} always targets the next ring. You cannot jump int → prod. The source ring must be healthy first.

flow.title: 3. Deploy with the right deployer
flow.text: KubectlDeployer (set image + rollout), GitHubActionsDeployer (workflow-dispatch for VM/CI apps), or k8sjob runner Jobs — selected per application.

flow.title: 4. Health-check with retries
flow.text: After deploy, HTTP health checks run with configurable retries. Optional version verification requires the endpoint to report the exact version just deployed.

flow.title: 5. Auto-rollback on failure
flow.text: If the target stays unhealthy, Ring Promoter rolls back to the previous version automatically and records the failure in history.

flow.title: 6. Optional auto-promote
flow.text: Flag a ring so a healthy landing continues onward in the same locked operation — e.g. auto-promote test → acc, but keep humans on the gate to prod.

rings.name: int

features.title: Why teams pick Ring Promoter for AI-era CI/CD
features.intro: AI products change fast — models, agents, MCP tools, gateways. Ring Promoter keeps promotions disciplined without freezing delivery.

items.title: Ordered rings, never skip
items.description: Shared pipeline int → test → acc → prod. Adding a ring is a single-place change in the ring package — apps declare where they live per ring in config, not code.

items.title: Health-gated promotion
items.description: Live health checks before and after promote. Optional health_version_field / header stops the classic false green: old pods answering 200 while the new version never rolled.

items.title: Automatic rollback
items.description: Failed health after retries restores the previous version. Seed, promote, and rollback are all audited — success or failure.

items.title: Kubernetes + VM/CI deployers
items.description: One control plane for kubectl rollouts, GitHub Actions workflow-dispatch (e.g. WSL Proxy on VMs), and Kubernetes Job executors with live logs.

items.title: Safe concurrency
items.description: Per-app serialization via Postgres session advisory locks across replicas. Operations detach from HTTP so LB timeouts cannot abort a rollback mid-flight.

items.title: UI + REST API
items.description: Embedded Next.js console and bearer-token REST API. Async deployment views stream progress for operators watching AI stack releases.

items.title: Config-driven apps
items.description: Add an application with YAML: namespaces, Deployments, image repos, health URLs, deployer type — no fork of Ring Promoter required.

items.title: Built for AI platforms
items.description: Promote agent services, MCP gateways, GPU inference front-doors, and TenthMatrix products through the same rings your platform team already trusts.

aiAngle.title: Built for AI-powered deployments
aiAngle.intro: Model weights, agent runtimes, and edge gateways ship on different cadences. Ring Promoter keeps every change on the same promotion protocol.
points: Promote AI agent APIs and MCP gateways through the same rings as classic services.
Version-verified health catches silent rollbacks when an old inference sidecar still answers OK.
Auto-promote early rings so research builds move fast; human gate stays on prod.
GitHub Actions deployer reuses existing AI/ML CI without rewriting pipelines.
Full history per (app, ring) for compliance reviews of what reached production.

architecture.title: Solution architecture
architecture.intro: Clean interfaces: Deployer, Executor, Health Checker, Store — swap production backends without rewriting promotion rules.

steps.title: Control plane
steps.text: Go service + embedded UI + REST API on k3s (or local).

steps.title: Rings
steps.text: Ordered pipeline defined once; apps map resources per ring.

steps.title: Deployers
steps.text: kubectl, GitHub Actions, or k8sjob executors per app.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: Postgres (prod) or memory (dev) with history and locks.
